name: Freedom Dollar
oneLiner: FUSD is the Zano privacy-chain dollar token with a self-published ZANO reserve dashboard; redemption is limited and it is not bridged to tracked Pharos chains.
collateral: The issuer's white paper describes fUSD backing as ZANO staked in a publicly observable reserve wallet. The reserve dashboard is self-reported; the native asset-owner key, rather than a collateral-enforcing DAO contract, controls issuance.
pegMechanism: Independent market-making bots trade existing fUSD and ZANO near the dollar target on the Zano DEX. The issuer describes additional ZANO reserves as its policy for new issuance; this policy is separate from the native asset-owner key's issuance power.

proofOfReserves.provider: Freedom Dollar self-reported reserve dashboard. After displaying dashes on 2026-10-01, the homepage again displayed circulating and minted tokens, ZANO reserve value and coverage on 2026-10-02. These issuer-reported figures are not an independent reserve attestation or a verified whole-claim reconciliation.

notices.title: Unsupported private chain
notices.message: FUSD primarily circulates on Zano, which is not a configured Pharos chain, so no contract is stored.
